SELECT COUNT(IN_TB.SEQ) FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ , A.TITLE , A.CONTENT , A.CNT , NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ , TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') REG_DATE , A.WORK_TYPE , C.CODE_NAME AS WORK_TYPE_NM , A.REG_ID , A.BOARD_GBN , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ) AS RNUM , B.EMP_NM FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A , CRM_EMP_MGT B , CRM_CODE_DETAIL C WHERE A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO AND C.CODE = NVL(A.WORK_TYPE,'P008') AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND C.P_CODE = 'CD03'
) IN_TB

SELECT IN_TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ , A.TITLE , A.CONTENT , A.CNT , NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ , TO_CHAR(A.REG_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') REG_DATE , A.WORK_TYPE , C.CODE_NAME AS WORK_TYPE_NM , A.REG_ID , A.BOARD_GBN , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.BEST_FAQ, A.SEQ) AS RNUM , B.EMP_NM , A.ONLYME_OPEN_YN , CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE - A.REG_DATE,0) <= 5 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS latest_post , (SELECT COUNT(SEQ) FROM CRM_FAQ_ANSWER S WHERE S.FAQ_SEQ = A.SEQ ) FAQ_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(SEQ) FROM CRM_BOARD_LIKE T WHERE T.SEQ = A.SEQ AND T.LIKE_YN = 'Y') LIKE_CNT , A.BEST_FAQ FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A , CRM_EMP_MGT B , CRM_CODE_DETAIL C WHERE A.REG_ID = B.EMP_NO AND C.CODE = NVL(A.WORK_TYPE,'P008') AND C.CODE_GROUP = 'AS' AND C.P_CODE = 'CD03'
) IN_TB WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} AND #{endRow, jdbcType=INTEGER} ORDER BY IN_TB.RNUM DESC

SELECT IN_TB.* ,(SELECT EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT WHERE EMP_NO = IN_TB.REG_ID) AS EMP_NM FROM ( SELECT SEQ, TITLE, CONTENT, CNT, NVL(ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, REG_DATE, REG_ID, BOARD_GBN ,WORK_TYPE ,( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = 'CD03' AND z.code = nvl(work_type,'P008') ) AS work_type_nm /* 업무유형 */ ,NVL(LEAD(SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY SEQ),0) NEXT_SEQ ,NVL(LAG(SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY SEQ),0) PREV_SEQ ,CASE WHEN onlyme_open_yn = 'N' THEN 'C001' ELSE 'C002' END AS OPEN_TYPE ,BEST_FAQ AS BEST_TYPE FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT WHERE BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.SEQ = #{seq}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.SEQ, A.TITLE, A.CONTENT, A.CNT, NVL(A.ATTACH_SEQ,0) ATTACH_SEQ, A.REG_DATE, A.REG_ID, A.BOARD_GBN ,A.WORK_TYPE ,( SELECT z.code_name FROM crm_code_detail z WHERE z.code_group = 'AS' AND z.p_code = 'CD03' AND z.code = nvl(A.work_type,'P008') ) AS work_type_nm /* 업무유형 */ ,NVL(LEAD(A.SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ),0) NEXT_SEQ ,NVL(LAG(A.SEQ,1) OVER (ORDER BY A.SEQ),0) PREV_SEQ ,CASE WHEN A.onlyme_open_yn = 'N' THEN 'C001' ELSE 'C002' END AS OPEN_TYPE ,B.LIKE_YN FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT A INNER JOIN CRM_BOARD_LIKE B ON A.SEQ = B.SEQ AND A.BOARD_GBN = B.BOARD_GBN WHERE A.BOARD_GBN = #{board_gbn} AND B.W_ID = #{emp_id} AND A.ONLYME_OPEN_YN = 'N' ) IN_TB WHERE IN_TB.SEQ = #{seq}
SELECT MAX_BOARD_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
select COUNT(SEQ) from CRM_BOARD_LIKE where SEQ = #{faq_seq} and LIKE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT NVL((SELECT Z.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE A.CRM_CODE = Z.CRM_CODE), '') AS W_CUST_NM, A.SEQ, A.FAQ_SEQ, A.W_ID, A.W_CONTENT, to_char(A.W_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') W_DATE, A.W_GUBUN, A.CRM_CODE, DECODE ( A.W_GUBUN ,'U' ,NVL(( SELECT X.EMP_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_ERP X WHERE A.W_ID = X.EMP_ID), '') ,'A' ,NVL(( SELECT E.EMP_NM FROM CRM_EMP_MGT E WHERE A.W_ID = E.EMP_NO), '')
) AS W_NM FROM CRM_FAQ_ANSWER A WHERE A.FAQ_SEQ = #{faq_seq} ORDER BY A.W_DATE DESC

SELECT NVL((SELECT Z.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE A.CRM_CODE = Z.CRM_CODE), '') AS W_CUST_NM, A.SEQ, A.BOARD_GBN, A.CRM_CODE, A.W_ID, NVL((SELECT Y.TEL_NO FROM CRM_CUST_ERP Y WHERE A.CRM_CODE = Y.CUST_CODE AND A.W_ID = Y.EMP_ID), '') AS W_TEL_NO, to_char(A.W_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') W_DATE, (SELECT T.TEL_NO FROM CRM_CUST_ERP T WHERE T.EMP_ID = A.W_ID) W_TEL_NO, (SELECT T.EMP_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_ERP T WHERE T.EMP_ID = A.W_ID) W_NM FROM CRM_BOARD_LIKE A WHERE A.SEQ = #{faq_seq} AND A.LIKE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.W_DATE DESC

SELECT NVL((SELECT Z.CUST_KOR_NAME FROM CRM_CUST_MGT Z WHERE A.CRM_CODE = Z.CRM_CODE), '') AS W_CUST_NM, A.SEQ, A.BOARD_GBN, A.CRM_CODE, A.W_ID, NVL((SELECT Y.TEL_NO FROM CRM_CUST_ERP Y WHERE A.CRM_CODE = Y.CUST_CODE AND A.W_ID = Y.EMP_ID), '') AS W_TEL_NO, to_char(A.W_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:mi:ss') W_DATE, A.LIKE_YN FROM CRM_BOARD_LIKE A WHERE A.SEQ = #{seq} AND A.W_ID = #{w_id} AND A.CRM_CODE = #{crm_code} ORDER BY A.W_DATE DESC

SELECT ROWNUM AS RNUM, SEQ, TITLE, REG_DATE, LATEST_POST FROM ( SELECT SEQ, TITLE, TO_CHAR(REG_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') REG_DATE, CASE WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE - REG_DATE,0) <= 5 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LATEST_POST FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT WHERE BOARD_GBN = '0001' AND ONLYME_OPEN_YN = 'N' AND BEST_FAQ = 'Y' ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC )
SELECT SEQ FROM CRM_BOARD_MGT WHERE NOTICE_NUM = #{seq}
